text: The send code shall exempt game turn posts from the per-author reply cap and limit them by a thread ceiling instead.
rationale: Council 11-12: the cap equalled the turn rate and chose each turn's parent (52 replies 11-05..11-11; turn 49 held).

text: A reply shall be classed as a game turn post only if its root and its parent's root both equal the configured game root URI.
acceptance: A draft with a different root, or whose parent has a different root, is classed ordinary.
rationale: The exemption is scoped to one thread.

text: A reply shall be classed as a game turn post only if its parent's author is not one of modulo, morphyx, mozzie or miniphim-works.
acceptance: A draft whose parent is one of our own posts is classed ordinary.
rationale: Only a player's ask is a request for a reply.

text: A reply shall be classed as a game turn post only if its parent's rkey is the first rkey on the post text's line beginning 'Asks:'.
acceptance: Parent = second listed rkey, or no Asks: line, is classed ordinary; parent = first listed rkey passes.
rationale: Morphyx 3: the parent is chosen by the post's own list, so the second key can check it.

text: A reply shall be classed as a game turn post only if its parent's indexedAt is at or after send time minus 86400 seconds.
acceptance: Parent indexedAt = send - 86400 s passes; send - 86400.001 s is classed ordinary.
rationale: The ask has to be recent. indexedAt, not createdAt (CHOICE 10-17).

text: A game turn post shall not be refused by the per-author cap and shall not count toward any author's per-author total, but shall count toward the 30-a-day total.
acceptance: With the parent's author at 2 replies today, a game turn post sends, and an ordinary reply to that author afterwards is still refused at 2 and allowed at 1.
rationale: Conversation replies to players stay capped as before.

text: The send code shall hold a game turn post if the previous game turn post's publish time is less than 10800 seconds earlier.
acceptance: Gap 10799 s is held in held.json; 10800 s sends.
rationale: Morphyx 2: the thread's own limit, matching the ~4 h seat.

text: A reply that fails any classification condition shall be sent under the ordinary cap, and held.json shall name the failed condition.
acceptance: Each of ROOT, ASKER, FIRST, 24H failing alone gives ordinary handling and that code in held.json when held.
rationale: Misclassification costs one held post, not a lost one, and the reason survives.
